Two dead in Delhi construction collapse
At least two bodies were recovered in northeastern Delhi on Monday morning after rescue workers conducted an overnight operation at the site of a collapsed house.

blocks.caption: The collapse reportedly took place around 7 p.m. (1330 GMT) on SundayImage: ANI/IMAGO

blocks.text: Local media reported that a massive slab of an under-construction house fell on the contractors of the building on Sunday evening, prompting national and regional rescue teams to arrive at the scene.
Authorities identified the deceased as 60-year-old Chanderpal and his 36-year-old son Vijay Kumar.

blocks.caption: The two deceased were taken to the hospital but declared dead on arrivalImage: ANI/IMAGO

blocks.text: India's capital has seen a number of building collapses off late, as illegal constructions, lack of maintenance and unimplemented safety standards threaten lives. In September, a five-storey building housing paying guest students collapsed killing at least seven.
